sections.title: Welcome to JPE Studio
sections.content: JPE stands for **Just Plain English** – a simple, readable syntax for creating The Sims 4 mods without complex XML or programming knowledge. Instead of fighting with tags, you write sentences that describe what your mod does.

items.title: Why use JPE?
items.content: JPE is designed to be **Human-Readable**, **Beginner-Friendly**, and **Industrial-Scale Ready**. It minimizes errors by using a clear, hierarchical structure (indentation) and plain English keywords.

items.title: Your First Mod
items.content:
Create a `.jpe` file and define an interaction. For example:

```jpe
My First Interaction
  description: "Hello World"
  tests:
    - actor is adult
```
Build it (Ctrl+B) and JPE Studio handles the rest.
items.playground:
My First Interaction
  description: "Hello World"
  tests:
    - actor is adult

sections.title: JPE Syntax Basics
sections.content: The foundation of JPE is **Indentation**. Like the game itself, JPE has a clear hierarchy.

items.title: Indentation (2 Spaces)
items.content:
Hierarchy is shown by indenting exactly **2 spaces**. Parent properties contain children.

```jpe
Parent
  Child Property: Value
  Nested Group:
    Grandchild: Value
```

items.title: Data Types
items.content:
- **Strings**: `"Like this"` (use quotes for spaces)
- **Numbers**: `100` or `0.75`
- **Lists**: Use `-` for multiple items (e.g., tests or effects).

sections.title: Core Concepts
sections.content: Mods are built from four primary blocks: Interactions, Buffs, Traits, and Tests.

items.title: Interactions (Actions)
items.content:
Interactions are what Sims *do*. They have descriptions, types, and conditions.

```jpe
Greet Sim
  type: social
  duration: 10
```
items.playground:
Greet Sim
  type: social
  duration: 10
  tests:
    - actor is happy

items.title: Buffs (Moodlets)
items.content:
Temporary emotional effects. They have intensity and duration.

```jpe
Feeling Fine
  mood_type: positive
  intensity: 2
  duration: 240
```

items.title: Tests (Conditions)
items.content: Tests determine if an action can happen. Examples: `actor is adult`, `actor has cooking skill >= 5`.

sections.title: Industrial Pro Utilities
sections.content: For professional modders managing massive libraries, JPE Studio includes high-fidelity binary tools.

items.title: Industrial Stream Writer
items.content: When updating massive mods (>1GB), JPE Studio uses a sequential binary stream writer. This ensures **zero memory crashes** by reconstructing files chunk-by-chunk instead of loading the whole file into RAM.

items.title: Size-Collision Optimization
items.content: The Mods Cleanup utility is optimized for industrial speed. It only hashes files if they share the exact same byte-size, reducing disk IO by **90%** on standard mod folders.

items.title: One-Click Manifest Update
items.content: You can patch mod version numbers and metadata directly in the binary without needing the original source XML or re-exporting from external tools.

sections.title: Advanced Techniques
sections.content: Mastering complex mod logic and conditional chains.

items.title: Advanced Conditional Nesting
items.content:
You can nest tests to create complex logic trees. A Sims 4 interaction can require multiple age, skill, and mood conditions simultaneously.

```jpe
Master Chef Kiss
  tests:
    - actor cooking skill >= 10
    - actor is inspired
    - target is food lover
```
items.playground:
Master Chef Kiss
  tests:
    - actor cooking skill >= 10
    - actor is inspired
    - target is food lover
